rationale: Cosmological term in 'all the worlds of ⲡⲁⲥⲉ' designating the domain of the six outer thrones. Possibly Lyc. ⲡⲁϣ 'half, division' — a cosmological half-region of the universe. Confidence low; awaiting parallels.
Lycopolitan ordinal: ⲙⲁⲍ- (ordinal prefix) + ⲙⲛⲧⲥⲛⲁⲩⲥ (12) = twelfth. Pattern matches ⲙⲁⲍⲥⲛⲉⲩ 'second,' ⲙⲁⲍⲩⲧⲟⲉ 'fourth,' ⲡⲙⲁⲍⲥⲁϣϩ 'seventh' already in vocabulary.
= ⲙⲛⲧϣⲙⲏⲛ 'eight.' Lyc. ⲝ for ⲧϣ. Used in chapter heading 'the eight great thrones.'
Standard divine epithet for the hidden Father, here identified with the great Throne of Honor (ⲡⲛⲁⲟ̄ ⲛ̄ⲫⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛⲡⲧⲁⲓⲟ) on which he sits. ⲧⲁⲓⲟ = 'honor.'
Standard Manichaean Father-epithet introducing the first of the eight thrones — the Father's own throne.

ⲙⲁⲛ- ('place of') + ⲙ̄ⲧⲁⲛ (= ⲙ̄ⲧⲟⲛ 'rest'). The eschatological place of rest where the disciples shall rest forever after receiving the kingship from the twelve judges. Standard Manichaean cosmological term for the upper realm of light/repose.
